name: Canyon Switchback Coordination
description: Multiple alternating barriers produce long switchback routes for multi-drone rendezvous and recovery. All 20 tasks are generated from the 10 submitted templates. Six heterogeneous drones, two genuinely moving couriers, four search cells, and ten charging stations are included. A full-height physical perimeter prevents shortcuts outside the mission boundary.
creator: LLM & Agent Course - 一起玩原神吧队

tasks.name: Cross Target Swap After Discovery
tasks.content: Drone Foxtrot should find target Far-Side Depot South, and drone Echo should find target Far-Side Depot North. After the first discovery, the drones swap assignments: Foxtrot goes to Far-Side Depot North and Echo goes to Far-Side Depot South at 22 meters.

tasks.name: Sequential Multi-Target Visit
tasks.content: Drone Echo performs sequential multi-target mission: take off to 25 meters, visit targets Echo Home Charger, Inspection West, and Bravo Home Charger in sequence. At each target, get within the target radius, hover for observation, and take a photo. Plan optimal route to minimize flight distance.
